name: KIMLUN
recent: Kimlun 与 Astaka Padu 合作开发柔佛新山价值 RM450 million 的服务式公寓项目，并签署补充认购与股东协议。公司于 2026 年 8 月完成私募资金运用的季度更新，同时公布 2026 年第二季度业绩，营收环比增长 20.9%，净利环比增长 99.0%。
notable: 与 Astaka Padu 合作开发柔佛新山价值 RM450 million 的服务式公寓项目。
签署补充认购与股东协议，修订和重述原有 SSA。
执行主席 Pang Tin @ Pang Yon Tin 于 2026 年 9 月 8 日和 10 日合计增持 6,080,000 股。
risks: 公司此前进行私募新股集资，最新季度更新披露资金运用情况。
执行董事 Sim Tian Liang 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日增持 150,000 股。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 MYR 513.715 million，环比增长 20.9%，同比增长 18.9%；净利为 MYR 22.388 million，环比增长 99.0%，同比下降 5.3%；净利率为 4.4%，上一季度为 2.6%。

recent_en: Kimlun is partnering with Astaka Padu to develop a RM450 million serviced residence project in Johor Bahru and has entered into a supplemental subscription and shareholders' agreement. The company provided a quarterly update on its private placement proceeds utilisation in August 2026 and reported Q2 2026 results with revenue up 20.9% QoQ and net income up 99.0% QoQ.
notable_en: Partnering with Astaka Padu to develop a RM450 million serviced residence project in Johor Bahru.
Entered into a supplemental subscription and shareholders' agreement to amend and restate the existing SSA.
Executive Chairman Pang Tin @ Pang Yon Tin acquired a total of 6,080,000 shares on 8 and 10 September 2026.
risks_en: The company previously undertook a private placement of new shares and provided a quarterly update on the utilisation of proceeds.
Executive Director Sim Tian Liang acquired 150,000 shares on 10 September 2026.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was MYR 513.715 million, up 20.9% QoQ and 18.9% YoY; net income was MYR 22.388 million, up 99.0% QoQ but down 5.3% YoY; net margin was 4.4% versus 2.6% in the previous quarter.
